title: dryopteris rigescens
intro: Dryopteris rigescens, commonly known as Rigescence Male Fern, is a type of fern plant that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. It is traditionally used in medicine due to its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris rigescens include its expectorant, antispasmodic, and diuretic effects, making it useful in treating coughs, colds, and other respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
